questions.name: Field Completeness
questions.description: Proportion of mandatory schema fields populated
questions.evidence: id: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; title: 'Cell Maps for Artificial Intelligence (CM4AI)'; description: ~1400-char narrative; keywords: 26 terms; license_and_use_terms: detailed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 block with license_terms list
questions.quality_note: All five mandatory fields present with substantive, high-quality content

questions.name: Entry Length Adequacy
questions.description: Whether narrative fields have meaningful content length
questions.evidence: description spans lines 10-27 (~1400 chars); motivation captured in four detailed 'purposes' entries (cm4ai:purpose:1-4), each 200-400 chars
questions.quality_note: Narrative fields greatly exceed the 200-char threshold with rich context

questions.name: Keyword Diversity
questions.description: Number of unique keywords describing topic coverage
questions.evidence: 26 unique keywords including 'Cell Maps', 'Spatial Proteomics', 'AP-MS', 'SEC-MS', 'Perturb-Seq', 'RO-Crate', 'FAIRSCAPE', 'Visible Neural Networks', 'MDA-MB-468', 'KOLF2.1J'
questions.quality_note: 26 keywords far exceed the ≥8 threshold and span modalities, cell lines, methods, and frameworks

questions.name: File Enumeration and Type Variety
questions.description: Number of files and file type diversity in distribution_formats
questions.evidence: distribution_formats lists 5 channels/types: RO-Crate/JSON-LD packages, MassIVE mass-spectrometry data, NCBI SRA sequence data, NDEx hierarchical cell maps, UVA Dataverse RO-Crates; also RGB IF images referenced
questions.quality_note: Clear multimodal variety (imaging, MS, sequencing, network graphs, RO-Crate); docked one point because concrete file extensions/formats per package are not enumerated

questions.name: Data File Size Availability
questions.description: Presence of file size or dimensional metadata
questions.evidence: Numeric dimensional/count metadata throughout: '563 proteins', '464 proteins with RGB images', '11,739 targeted genes', 'over 1,000 complexes', 'over 700 protein complexes', '10 layers of depth', '6 guide RNAs per gene', '72/100 chromatin modifiers'
questions.quality_note: Rich sample/entity-count dimensional metadata present; byte-level file sizes not given but not required to pass

questions.name: Dataset Identification Metadata
questions.description: Presence of unique identifiers such as DOI, RRID, or persistent URLs
questions.evidence: id: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; additional DOIs 10.18130/V3/B35XWX, F3TD5R, K7TGEM; cell-line RRIDs RRID:CVCL_0419 and RRID:CVCL_B5P3; page: https://www.cm4ai.org
questions.quality_note: Multiple persistent identifiers including dataset DOIs and cell-line RRIDs

questions.name: Funding and Acknowledgements Completeness
questions.description: Presence of funding sources, grants, or institutional sponsors
questions.evidence: 'NIH grant 1OT2OD032742-01 (Bridge2AI Functional Genomics) and 5U54HG012513-02 (Bridge2AI Bridge Center) ... Opportunity Number: OTA-21-008. Project dates: September 1, 2022 to August 31, 2026. FY 2025 funding: $5,289,382 ... Additional funding from the Frederick Thomas Fund of the University of Virginia'
questions.quality_note: Agency, two award numbers, dates, budget breakdown, and acknowledgment of an additional fund all present

questions.name: Ethical and Privacy Declarations
questions.description: Presence of deidentification methods, IRB approvals, or ethical sourcing notes
questions.score_label: IRB/ethics disposition + deidentification + ethical sourcing details
questions.evidence: human_subject_research: 'considered to be de-identified as they cannot be matched ... commercially available, ethically sourced, de-identified cell lines'; irb_approval: 'Not applicable - de-identified cell lines from commercial sources'; ethics_review_board lists CM4AI Ethics Module and Data Access Committee; sensitive_elements documents donor-metadata handling
questions.quality_note: Comprehensive, well-justified ethics documentation appropriate to non-clinical cell-line data (deidentification rationale, ethical sourcing, dedicated ethics module and governance)

questions.name: Access Requirements Documentation
questions.description: Whether access policy and license are clearly defined
questions.score_label: License + Data Access Committee + platform access description
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms details CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, 'Commercial use requires separate license negotiation', 'A Data Access Committee (led by Jillian Parker) supervises ethical matters related to dataset distribution'; access via DOIs, MassIVE, SRA, NDEx, UVA Dataverse; KOLF2.1J 'via a simple MTA'
questions.quality_note: Access path fully specified across platforms plus DAC oversight and dual-licensing policy

questions.name: Interoperability and Standardization
questions.description: Presence of standard formats, ontologies, or schema conformance
questions.evidence: 'RO-Crate format using the FAIRSCAPE framework'; 'metadata in JSON-LD using Schema.org and EVI vocabularies'; 'JSON-Schema mini-data-dictionaries'; ontology mapping to Gene Ontology, Reactome, PDB, AlphaFoldDB, NCI Thesaurus, BioAssay Ontology, Cell Ontology, CHEBI, EFO
questions.quality_note: Standard packaging formats plus extensive schema and ontology conformance

questions.name: Tool and Software Transparency
questions.description: Mentions of preprocessing libraries or tools used in data preparation
questions.evidence: MuSIC pipeline, node2vec, Human Protein Atlas deep learning model, contrastive deep learning, Cytoscape multiscale community detection, FAIRSCAPE-CLI, 'Integrative Modeling Platform (IMP) version 2.18', Python Modeling Interface, 10x Genomics 3'HT kit, ndex2 library; FAIRSCAPE docs at https://fairscape.github.io
questions.quality_note: Broad, well-documented toolchain with one explicit version (IMP 2.18) and a documentation URL; docked one point because most tools lack version pins

questions.name: Collection Protocol Clarity
questions.description: Description completeness of recruitment and data acquisition
questions.evidence: collection_mechanisms and acquisition_methods give per-modality protocols: 'Automated fixation and permeabilization ... using pipetting robot', 'Endogenous tagging ... 17 genes endogenously tagged in MDA-MB-468 ... under three conditions', 'SEC-MS ... Performed in Krogan Laboratory at UCSF', 'CRISPR lentiviral library ... 6 guide RNAs per gene ... 10x Genomics 3'HT kit'
questions.quality_note: Highly detailed acquisition protocols with instruments, labs, conditions, and antibody sources

questions.name: Version History Documentation
questions.description: Presence of multiple version records and associated dates
questions.score_label: ≥2 versions with change summaries and release dates
questions.evidence: update_details: 'Alpha release v0.5', 'March 2025 Beta release V1.4 (doi:10.18130/V3/B35XWX)', 'June 2025 Beta release V2.1 (doi:10.18130/V3/F3TD5R)', 'October 2025 Beta release (doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM)', each with a change summary (e.g. 'V2.1 revision adds RGB IF images ... plus SEC-MS for MDA-MB-468')
questions.quality_note: Four dated releases with per-version DOIs and change descriptions

questions.name: Associated Publications
questions.description: Presence of formal citations or DOI-linked references
questions.score_label: Multiple references and dataset DOI cross-links
questions.evidence: Nature: doi:10.1038/s41586-025-08878-3 (Schaffer, Hu et al., April 2025); bioRxiv preprint: doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311; Perturbation Cell Atlas: doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734 (PMCID: PMC11580897); citations cross-linked to dataset DOI in license terms
questions.quality_note: Three DOI-linked publications plus explicit citation requirements tying publications to the dataset DOI

questions.name: Human Subject Representation
questions.description: Inclusion of human subjects, demographic diversity, or subgroup details
questions.evidence: special_populations: 'MDA-MB-468 derived from 51-year-old black female (de-identified)', 'KOLF2.1J derived from healthy male Northern European donor (de-identified)'; 7 subpopulations enumerated (untreated/paclitaxel/vorinostat MDA-MB-468; undifferentiated iPSC, neurons, NPCs, cardiomyocytes); sampling selection criteria given
questions.quality_note: Donor demographics and seven experimental subpopulations well characterized; not full human-subject demographic diversity since these are de-identified cell lines (no human subjects), hence 4 rather than 5

questions.name: Findability (Persistent Links)
questions.description: Dataset includes persistent URLs for access and documentation
questions.evidence: page: https://www.cm4ai.org; persistent DOIs (10.18130/V3/DXWOS5 and others); external_resources with NIH RePORTER (reporter.nih.gov/project-details/11211616), NDEx, FAIRSCAPE, publications
questions.quality_note: Multiple persistent, resolvable URLs for access and documentation

questions.name: Accessibility (Access Mechanism)
questions.description: Describes how users can obtain the dataset
questions.score_label: Fully defined access path (platform, policy, agreements)
questions.evidence: distribution_formats specify DOI landing pages, MassIVE, NCBI SRA/BioProject, NDEx (Cytoscape/HiView/ndex2), UVA Dataverse; access governed by CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, Data Access Committee, MTA for KOLF2.1J, and commercial-license negotiation
questions.quality_note: Access mechanism fully defined across repositories with governance and agreement terms

questions.name: Reusability (License Clarity)
questions.description: License is clearly defined and permits identifiable reuse cases
questions.evidence: license: 'CC BY-NC-SA 4.0'; license_terms: 'Attribution required', 'Non-commercial use only (commercial requires separate license)', 'Share-alike', 'Must cite Nature publication and bioRxiv preprint and data collection DOI'; link to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
questions.quality_note: Standard license with explicitly enumerated reuse conditions and citation obligations

questions.name: Data Integrity and Provenance
questions.description: Presence of change logs or provenance tracking
questions.evidence: 'FAIRSCAPE server assigns persistent resolvable globally unique identifiers (ARK scheme) ... computes end-to-end provenance entailments using EVI Evidence Graph Ontology'; 'machine-readable provenance graphs'; dated release log (Alpha v0.5 → Oct 2025 Beta) each with DOI
questions.quality_note: Machine-readable provenance graphs plus dated, DOI-versioned release history

questions.name: Interlinking Across Platforms
questions.description: Metadata connects dataset records across multiple platforms
questions.evidence: external_resources link CM4AI to NIH RePORTER, UVA Dataverse/LibraData, NDEx (ndexbio.org), MassIVE, NCBI SRA/BioProject, FAIRSCAPE (fairscape.github.io), Integrative Modeling Platform, Bridge2AI program, NIH CFDE, and three publication DOIs
questions.quality_note: Extensive verified cross-platform interlinking across repositories, registries, and publications

strengths: Exemplary FAIR and interoperability documentation: RO-Crate/FAIRSCAPE packaging, JSON-LD with Schema.org and EVI, and mapping to GO, Reactome, PDB, AlphaFoldDB, CHEBI, Cell Ontology, and NCI Thesaurus
Complete funding metadata with two NIH award numbers, opportunity number, project dates, and FY2025 budget breakdown
Structured version history: four dated Beta/alpha releases each carrying its own DOI and change summary
Multiple DOI-linked publications (Nature, two bioRxiv preprints) cross-linked to the dataset via explicit citation requirements
Highly detailed, per-modality collection and acquisition protocols naming labs, instruments, antibody sources, and treatment conditions
Machine-readable provenance via ARK identifiers and EVI Evidence Graphs, plus broad cross-platform interlinking (Dataverse, NDEx, MassIVE, SRA, RePORTER)
weaknesses: Distribution formats are described at the repository/modality level rather than by concrete file extensions or per-package file sizes
Software toolchain is comprehensive but only partially version-pinned (IMP 2.18 is the sole explicit version)
Human/donor representation is limited to two de-identified cell-line donors; no cohort-scale demographic diversity (inherent to this cell-line dataset)
Byte-level file sizes and array-shape dimensions are absent; dimensional metadata is expressed only as entity/sample counts
recommendations: Enumerate concrete file formats and approximate sizes per distribution package (e.g., OME-TIFF/PNG for IF images, mzML for MS, FASTQ for SRA, CX2 for NDEx)
Add version pins or release tags for MuSIC, FAIRSCAPE-CLI, node2vec, and the Human Protein Atlas model alongside the existing IMP 2.18
Include representative array dimensions or file sizes (e.g., image resolution, spectra counts) in composition or distribution entries
Where available, add per-release DOIs to a machine-readable versions list to complement the narrative update log
